title: host.servers.list (platform → host)
description: Asks for the inventory now: the host sends host.inventory (ref = this id), then host.result ok. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
